Class SecurityFindingAnnotationProperties

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.EntityProperties

org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.ReferenceableProperties

org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.surveyreports.AnnotationProperties
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.surveyreports.SecurityFindingAnnotationProperties
Direct Known Subclasses:
PenetrationTestFindingAnnotationProperties, VulnerabilityAnnotationProperties
public class SecurityFindingAnnotationProperties extends AnnotationProperties
SecurityFindingAnnotationProperties describes a weakness found in a resource by a security test, such as a vulnerability scan or a penetration test.
